title: Post a task
intro: Tell nearby helpers what you need. You can check everything before you post.
saved: Your draft stays in this tab until you post.
storageUnavailable: Your browser couldn't save this draft. Keep this tab open until you post.
restored: Your draft is ready to continue.
checkFields: Check the highlighted details to continue.
unsupportedOption: Choose an available option for this task.

category.label: What do you need help with?
category.hint: Choose a category for your task.

scope.furniture-assembly: Desks, beds, shelves, and other flat-pack furniture.
scope.moving-help: Loading, unloading, and moving things around your home.
scope.yard-cleanup: Leaves, weeding, and light yard tidying.
scope.light-cleaning: Everyday cleaning for rooms, kitchens, and bathrooms.
scope.computer-help: Device setup, troubleshooting, and a patient how-to.

itemType.label: What needs assembling?
itemType.hint: Choose the main item. Add other items in your description.

itemCount.label: Number of items
itemCount.hint: Count each separate piece of furniture.

brand.label: Brand or model
brand.hint: A name or model number helps the helper prepare.

elevator.label: Is there an elevator?
elevator.hint: Let the helper know how to reach the room.

wallAnchoring.label: Does it need wall anchoring?
wallAnchoring.hint: Check the furniture instructions for anchoring requirements.

toolsOnSite.label: Do you have tools available?
toolsOnSite.hint: If not, the helper can plan to bring their own.

moveType.label: What moving help do you need?
moveType.hint: You arrange the vehicle. Helpers provide the loading and moving help.

rooms.label: Number of rooms
rooms.hint: Count the rooms with items that need moving.

heavyItems.label: Heavy or bulky items
heavyItems.hint: For example, a couch, dresser, or queen bed.

stairFlights.label: Flights of stairs
stairFlights.hint: Use 0 if there are no stairs.

elevator.label: Is there an elevator?
elevator.hint: This helps the helper plan for larger items.

yardSize.label: Yard size
yardSize.hint: Choose the closest size for the area that needs work.

work.label: What needs doing?
work.hint: Choose the main task and add specifics in your description.

greenWastePlan.label: What happens to the bagged leaves and debris?
greenWastePlan.hint: Helpers bag everything on site. They can’t take it away.

options.curbside: Leave it at the curb for city pickup
options.poster_handles: Leave it in my yard; I’ll handle it

toolsOnSite.label: Do you have yard tools available?
toolsOnSite.hint: List available tools and bags in your description.

bedrooms.label: Number of bedrooms
bedrooms.hint: Count only bedrooms included in this task.

bathrooms.label: Number of bathrooms
bathrooms.hint: Count only bathrooms included in this task.

suppliesOnSite.label: Do you have cleaning supplies?
suppliesOnSite.hint: Mention any products you prefer in your description.

pets.label: Will pets be at home?
pets.hint: Let the helper know what to expect when they arrive.

device.label: Which device needs help?
device.hint: Choose the main device and describe any others.

need.label: What kind of help?
need.hint: No technical terms needed. Choose the closest option.

deviceBrand.label: Device brand or model
deviceBrand.hint: Add it if you know it. You can leave this blank.

schedule.policy: Choose a start at least {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} from now and no more than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ahead. All times are in {market}.
schedule.dateHint: Pick a day for the task.
schedule.timingHint: Give a time window or leave the day flexible.
schedule.startTooSoon: Pick a start at least {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} from now.
schedule.endAfterStart: Pick an end time after the start time.

budget.type: How would you like to price this?
budget.typeHint: Helpers can respond with offers. You review the full price before booking.
budget.priceHint: Enter dollars. The minimum for this category is {minimum}.
budget.rateHint: Enter the amount in dollars for each hour.
budget.minimumHours: This category has a minimum of {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
budget.hoursCapHint: The maximum hours you agree to, in half-hour steps.
budget.expenseHint: Set aside an amount for agreed supplies or materials. The helper provides receipts.
budget.expenseDescriptionHint: Name the supplies or materials the helper may need.

describe.title: Task title
describe.titleHint: A short summary, such as assembling a desk.
describe.description: What do you need help with?
describe.descriptionHint: Include what needs doing, what is ready, and what the helper should bring.
describe.aiHint: Start with your own words. You can review and edit the suggestion. Nothing is posted automatically.
describe.aiInputHint: A few notes are enough. Leave out contact details and your exact address.
describe.questions: Things to check before you post
describe.used: Suggestion added. You can still edit the title, description, and details.
describe.prohibitedLink: See tasks we cannot help with

errors.unavailable: Suggestions are unavailable right now. Try again or continue with your own description.
errors.rate_limited: You've requested several suggestions. Wait a little and try again, or write your own description.
errors.prohibited: We cannot help with something in these notes. Check the tasks we cannot help with and update your description.

photos.label: Add photos (optional)
photos.hint: Add up to {count} photos, up to {megabytes} MB each. JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC are accepted.
photos.privacy: Keep house numbers, mail, and faces out of the frame.
photos.count: {count, plural, =0 {No photos added} one {# photo added} other {# photos added}}
photos.restoredHint: This photo is saved with your draft. Its preview will be available after posting.

errors.too_large: This photo is too large. Choose a photo under {megabytes} MB.
errors.unsupported_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC photo.
errors.too_many: You can add up to {count} photos. Remove one before adding another.
errors.rate_limited: Photos are uploading too quickly. Wait a little and try again.
errors.unknown: This photo did not upload. Try again.

location.modeHint: Choose in-person help or, when available for this category, remote help.

errors.not_supported: This category needs in-person help. Choose In person to continue.

location.remoteHint: Meet online. Share meeting details with your booked helper.
location.searchHint: Type at least 3 characters, then choose your address.
location.empty: No matching addresses. Try a street name or ZIP code.
location.failed: Address search is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
location.outOfArea: We're not in that area yet.
location.privateHint: Your exact address goes only to the helper you book.
location.unitHint: Only your booked helper sees this.
location.accessHint: Only your booked helper sees this. Include entry instructions, parking, or stairs.
location.restoreHint: Your address choice is saved. Search again if you need to change it.

review.intro: Check your task and who can see each part. You can go back to change anything before posting.
review.areaUnavailable: General area of your selected address
review.savedPhoto: Photo {number} is saved. Its preview will appear after posting.
review.privacy: Helpers see only the general area. Your exact address is shared with your helper after you book.
review.addressSaved: Your selected address is saved. Go back to Where to view or change it.
review.remotePrivacy: This is a remote task. No address is shared.
review.priceTitle: If you book at this price
review.priceError: We couldn't load the price breakdown. Try again to see what you'll pay when you book.
review.payment: You pay when you book. Your helper is paid after the task is done.

previews.when-flexible: Any time on the selected day
